Loader failure scope, settled by the operator from the accepted failure rule (Jack Heart: "is this just adding a reason onto failed, a failed retry = true"; an author exception is retry=false unless it raises the retry exception). Option 1a: when load raises, every undelivered scheduled match seating that player is recorded failed with retry=false and the load error; matches not seating it carry on; the run fails. A load that raises the retry exception (e.g. a transient fetch) makes those matches failed with retry=true instead. Reason: a raising loader is a property of the player (bad checkpoint, observation-ABI drift as on 2026-11-11), so 1b would re-rent and fail again on every pass. Revisable if Jack Heart says otherwise.
